Viator.com - Security Notice

This is a PoC by Ricko Darmawan (darmawanricko54@gmail.com)

Vulnerability: Subdomain Takeover via Feedburner MyBrand - feeds.travelblog.viator.com

Impact: I can host arbitrary content under trusted viator.com domain. This page is served from feeds.travelblog.viator.com which is CNAME to feeds.feedburner.com and unclaimed.

Proof of Control: If you see this, I control this subdomain.

For Bugcrowd Triager: This demonstrates P3 Subdomain Takeover - Arbitrary Content Hosting on in-scope viator.com asset.
